rules.tiers: high >=1%, mid 0.1-1%, low <0.1% of CC pages
rules.per_tier: 5 Latin + 3 other script, >=2 non-Latin script families, all MGSM languages
rules.overall: <=1 language per subgroup, <=2 per WALS genus
rules.objective: sum_k var(tier means of k)/var_k over k in ck, mx, gm; ties -> more genera, then alphabetical

excluded.zh-tw: script variant of zh-cn; Common Crawl reports one share for Chinese
